name: Domain Expiry Check (Cronsole)
description: Look a domain up over RDAP and fail the run when its registration expires within your warning window. No API key; complements the SSL expiry check, which cannot see a domain that lapses with a valid certificate.

parameters.label: Domain
parameters.help: The registered domain, without a subdomain — e.g. example.com.

parameters.label: Warn within (days)
parameters.help: Fail the run when fewer than this many days remain before the registration expires.
